title: Assignments and participant experience
summary: Connect proven local protocol and map components into an understandable, authorized participant journey.

goals.title: Signed Assignment prototype
goals.description: The bounded Protocol-2 implementation and tested local signing/verification behavior.

milestones.title: Protocol-2 signed Assignment prototype
milestones.description: Package 0.2.1 supplies strict versioned records, pinned-role verification, exact financial grants, immutable terms and local signing/import/export workflows. The 28 September milestone and later checks cover synthetic protocol behavior, not real-money launch readiness.
acceptance: The tested Protocol-2 cases enforce exact signed terms, role authority and admitted grants/revisions.
Covered correction cases preserve established obligations and expose unresolved alternatives.
Local signing/export and native/WASM parity checks cover the bounded prototype.

goals.title: Shared map inspection
goals.description: The reusable map component and its recorded geographic-policy and browser checks.

milestones.title: Isolated shared map inspection component
milestones.description: The 10 October shared map checkpoint covers geographic/deployment inspection and browser behavior. Its snapshot route collections are isolated from caller mutation across construction, clear, access and catalog resets. The component remains a local inspection surface; it establishes no deployed participant discovery or task marketplace.
acceptance: Shared map behavior and geographic policy are explicit and inspectable.
Controller snapshots isolate route collections from caller mutation, including empty/reset states.
Browser checks cover the documented component and narrow layouts.
Deployment/discovery fixtures do not imply a live service.
